posts.content:
Most companies’ AI fluency frameworks measure the same three things: tools used, frequency, and tokens consumed. 

Those metrics tell you how frequently someone reaches for AI. They don't tell you whether that person is producing better work or making smarter decisions.

At Lattice, we think a lot about what it means for humans and AI to work well together. 

That's why we built an AI Fluency Framework and added these competencies into every Lattician's Grow track:  

1. Structural Understanding: knowing how AI tools produce output, which tool fits which task, and where the guardrails are.
2. Judgement: applying your own expertise to evaluate AI output, and owning the final product.
3. Conscious Delegation: deciding what to hand to AI, what autonomy it gets, and what stays human-owned.
4. Learning Velocity: the drive to keep learning new skills and new ways of working.
5. Force Multiplier: turning your AI-driven workflow into something reusable for others.
(+ Five more competencies for managers.)

We believe HR is at its best when we learn from each other. We've packaged the framework into a free template for people leaders: https://lnkd.in/gC5e-SGF
